record.question: What do you mean by phase sequence RYB?
options: It denotes phase R, Y and B
It is the standard manufacturer's nomenclature
It is the sequence in which the voltage across R, Y and B attain their maximum values
It denotes the colour of the wire
record.explanation: Phase sequence RYB describes the temporal order in which the three-phase voltages reach their peak (maximum) values during each cycle.
